windows.notes: Refract 2.0.0: new Settings and Home, badges and levels, presets and app rules, themes, insights, rewrites that do not fail, a notch handle that stays hidden until you reach for it, light strips on Windows and Linux. Full notes in docs/releases/2.0.0.md

mac.notes: Google Gemini providers now show the Google logo in Settings on Mac and Linux, including renamed ones. Microsoft Store builds no longer show PayPal purchase buttons.
